<div class="card-body">
'''Blast The Door, Kid!''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ドアをふさげ！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">屋内の位置カードで戦闘が宣言された時に使用する。1フォースを使用し、すべてのリーダーと能力値＞2のキャラクターをその戦闘から完全に除外する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Blast-The-Door-Kid-SWCA-67698.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ベイダーが脱出を図る反乱軍に目を向けたその時、ハンはルークに向かって叫び、的確な指示を与えた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Block the door!

'''Card text:'''
Use when a battle is declared at an interior location card. Use 1 Force to completely exclude all leaders and all characters with ability > 2 from that battle.

'''Lore:'''
When Vader turned his attention to the Rebels trying to escape, Han shouted to Luke and gave a precise order.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English excludes those characters on both sides.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blast The Door, Kid!]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
